lines.text: عرض باشد و هر کوکب که با راس و ذنب باشد عرضش نباشد و چون بر زحل اینجاست که
lines.en: latitude, and any planet that is with the Head and Tail [Nodes] has no latitude. And since Saturn is here, which

lines.text: دوري او از حمل هشتاد و دو درجه بود اما شمس را راس
lines.en: its distance from Aries was eighty-two degrees, but the Sun's Head

lines.text: حمل است و ذنب میزان و از ان مشتري مریخ راس و زهره و عطارد
lines.en: is Aries and Tail is Libra, and of Jupiter, Mars, the Head, and Venus and Mercury

lines.text: و قمر معروفست و در تقویمها نویسند باب هفدهم در بیان
lines.en: and the Moon is known and they write it in the ephemerides. Chapter Seventeen: On the explanation of

lines.text: صعود و هبوط افتاب بدانکه افتاب از اول درجه حمل تا اخر
lines.en: the ascent and descent of the Sun. Know that the Sun from the first degree of Aries to the end of

lines.text: سنبله شمالي باشد و از اول میزان تا اخر حوت جنوبي و چون افتاب با ول نقطه
lines.en: Virgo is northern, and from the first of Libra to the end of Pisces is southern. And when the Sun reaches the first point of

lines.text: حمل رسد شب و روز با یکدیگر راست شود و روز زیادت میشود و شب نقصان
lines.en: Aries, night and day become equal to each other, and the day increases and the night decreases.

lines.text: و اخر جوزا انجا اطول النهار باشد و افتاب صاعد و شمالي باشد و چون بنقطه سرطان
lines.en: And at the end of Gemini, there is the longest day, and the Sun is ascending and northern. And when it reaches the point of Cancer,

lines.text: رسد روز میکاهد و شب مي افزاید تا اخر سنبله انجا روز و شب با یکدیگر راست
lines.en: the day decreases and the night increases until the end of Virgo, there day and night are equal to each other.

lines.text: راست شود و افتاب هابط و شمالي باشد و چون بنقطه میزان اید تا اخر قوس
lines.en: And the Sun is descending and northern. And when it comes to the point of Libra until the end of Sagittarius,

lines.text: شب مي افزاید و روز میکاهد و افتاب صاعد و جنوبي باشد و از نقطه اول
lines.en: the night increases and the day decreases, and the Sun is ascending and southern. And from the first point of

lines.text: جدي تا اخر حوت روز مي افزاید و شب میکاهد و افتاب صاعد و جنوبي باشد
lines.en: Capricorn to the end of Pisces, the day increases and the night decreases, and the Sun is ascending and southern.

lines.text: و صعود و هبوط افتاب در این دایره توهم کنند
lines.en: And they imagine the ascent and descent of the Sun in this circle.

summary.headline: Sun’s Ascent and Descent
summary.text: Chapter Seventeen explains the Sun’s northern and southern latitude, ascent and descent, and the changing lengths of day and night from Aries through Pisces, including the equinoctial points and longest day. It also notes planetary latitude, the Head and Tail (Nodes), Saturn, and ephemerides.
